{{Top|leg}}
The '''Cabana Bar''' was the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] [[Sanads of Rorkee]], in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Rorkee]], [[Genarius]]. It was managed by [[Hurrwarr]], a cleaning-[[Obsessive-compulsive disorder|obsessed]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] with a penchant for coasters.

The Bar included drinks from all throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and dancing [[Music/Legends|music]] commonly with live bands during the evenings. In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the band was [[Geedo Loken and the Lo-keys]]. The Bar also included a feature called ''The Pool Bar'', where the customers could drink while in the [[Water/Legends|water]]; the Bar provided them with floating cups to avoid unexpected surprises.

Although Hurrwarr could throw any hooligan out of his bar, or more than one at a time, locals tried to convince newcomers to play [[Stump-the-Wookiee-Bartender]], a supposed game with predictable results.

In 31 BBY, a guest of the hotel named [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Shilaea Motacc]] was a common sight in the bar, as she enjoyed [[Double-Dip Outer Rim Rumdrop]]s. Two days after Dr. Motacc was given up for [[Death/Legends|dead]] after a cave-in, a stranger went to the Cabana Bar and bought all the available stock of Rumdrops, paying in cash and during Hurrwarr's break. The stranger left a pair of [[spectacles]] on the bar.
